# Town of Braintree municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Braintree Selectboard members: Loren Bent, Chelsie Brown, Daniel Burson (Chair), Colin Evans, and Lou Helmuth.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Colin Evans (three-year term) and Loren Bent (two-year term) to the Selectboard in 2026.
Town of Braintree official website, Town Clerk page: 'Town Clerk & Treasurer: Jessica Brassard'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jessica Brassard as Town Clerk of Braintree and as Town Treasurer of Braintree.
Town of Braintree official website, Town Clerk page: 'Town Clerk & Treasurer: Jessica Brassard'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jessica Brassard as Town Clerk of Braintree and as Town Treasurer of Braintree.
Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 1 elected Jackson Evans Moderator for 2026.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Grace Persons Lister (three-year term) in 2026. The other two lister seats' holders are published in no official source, so only Persons is recorded.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Allison Jassen Auditor (three-year term) in 2026. The other two auditor seats' holders are published in no official source, so only Jassen is recorded.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Jessica Brassard Delinquent Tax Collector (one-year term) in 2026.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Stephen Brassard First Constable (one-year term) in 2026 (a distinct person from Town Clerk Jessica Brassard).

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): Article 5 elected Nancy Burchfield Cemetery Commissioner (three-year term) in 2026. The other seats' holders are published in no official source, so only Burchfield is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): the Article 5 officer elections include no grand juror, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded. (The same meeting eliminated the Trustee of Public Funds office by vote, Article 3; no post is created for it.)
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.

Town of Braintree, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026; posted on the town's official website as draft/unapproved minutes of the floor elections): the Article 5 officer elections include no town agent, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Braintree justices of the peace: Richard Bowen, Robert Moyer, Sherri Richardson, Katja Evans, and Jackson Evans.
